title: A text prompt is seconds to minutes of streaming; an agent session is hours on every yardstick
subtitle: Watt-hours for one unit of AI work, and the same energy in streaming time.
text: The same model, three more ways: heavy AI work against a video yardstick, inside the data center per person per day, and all of ChatGPT's text messages against the buildout.

plot.axis_label: Watt-hours, each mark ten times the last; under each value, the same energy in streaming time

reading: {label}: about {display}; text prompts, {prompts}; hours of this yardstick, {yard}, {hours}. {evidence}
details: The whole-chain yardsticks include the viewer's screen and router, so they flatter AI; the data center yardstick is like for like but rests on an unsettled allocation of serving energy, so a prompt's reading on it moves with the setting.
